brief: Can a retry after a timeout book one invoice twice? Prove it with a failing test, then recommend the fix.

lead-plan.body: Plan: Timeout proves the bug with a failing test, Fixtures finds a fake API, and I check the fix against the brief.

assign-timeout.body: Write a test that shows a retry after a timeout sends a second request for the same invoice.

assign-fixtures.body: List the fixtures in tests/ that fake the accounting API.

timeout-blocked.body: I cannot make the first API call time out in a test. Is there a fake API that times out once?

lead-asks-fixtures.body: Timeout is blocked on a fake API that times out once. Send it what you found.

fixtures-evidence.body: SlowOnceApi in tests/test_client.py:6 raises Timeout on the first call and records every request_id.

timeout-resume.body: Unblocked: SlowOnceApi works. Writing the test now.

fixtures-handoff.body: You already use the only API fixture. Take my task and close it with your test.

timeout-accept.body: Accepted. One fixture covers both tasks.

timeout-done.body: Done: test_retry_reuses_request_id fails today. The two attempts send different request IDs.
